threshold_rationale: Empirically calibrated from val+test predictions (n=70) on the local Phase 8 dataset. Correct predictions: confidence range [0.36, 0.99], mean 0.87. Incorrect predictions: confidence range [0.02, 0.56], mean 0.21. Unlike tiny_multimodal_v1, separation is imperfect -- there is a real overlap zone (0.36-0.56) where both correct and incorrect predictions occur, so 0.45 is a reasonable midpoint rather than a clean boundary. Documented honestly rather than implying a cleaner separation than what was measured.
task_summary: 157-class screenshot QA classifier: pretrained MobileNetV3-Small (frozen, ImageNet) backbone with a LoRA adapter (rank=8) on the final conv, char-level text encoder, trained on a 699-QA local reproduction of dataset v3's auto-generated majority (see docs/MODEL_SELECTION.md).
